newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish NIF index estimated at 160.0 on NFIs debut.
newsitem.headline: Polish NIF index estimated at 160.0 on NFIs debut.

text.p: The National Investment Funds all-share NIF index was estimated at 160.0 points in the NFIs bourse debut on Thursday, Reuter calculations based on preliminary figures showed.
The NIF is calculated as a sum of shares, one in each of the 15 NFIs.
NFI units representing the NFI funds, and exchangeable for 15 shares, one in each fund, traded at 150 zlotys in the single price auction system.
